The '''Ice Flower Star''', added in [[Update_Log#Update_7_-_Black_Clover_Update_Part_1|Update 7]], is a reward obtained from reaching Room 100 in the [[Infinity Castle]] (2nd Season). This item has become '''unobtainable''' as of Update 8.
